what: Statistical invariants (do not violate; test at these boundaries)
title: circumplex — assistant instructions
text: Angles: degrees [0, 360) user API, LM = 360 0 (norms tables octants() use 360). Radians internally via circumplex_degree/circumplex_radian S3 classes. Contrasts: second minus first factor level (alphabetical unless factor), reported (-180°, 180°] via angle_dist(). Displacement CIs use circular quantiles (center circular mean, unwrap, quantile, re-wrap); contrast CIs may legitimately negative, reported branch estimate (endpoints may exceed ±180° near boundary; see DESIGN.md). change touching displacement, contrasts, src/ requires tests : profiles peaking 0°/360°, CIs straddling 0°/360°, contrasts near ±180°, flat (zero-variance) profiles. Closed-form SSM estimator equals OLS equally spaced angles.

text: Recorded 2026-07-07 devel/m4-coverage-oracle.R (seeded; results devel/m4-coverage-oracle-results.rds / -analytic.rds): 500 replications per cell, nominal-95% CIs, p = 8 octant truths ζ = .75 two β configurations — “boundary” (.45/.35/.15/.05, small trailing harmonic) “interior” (.35/.30/.20/.15). Bootstrap cells used 1000 resamples. Analytic-ladder: interior truths reach [.90, .98] band N = 2000 stay; boundary truths stay badly outside N = 20000 (angle .70–.81) recover N = 50000 (.934) — matching -review F1 finding. record decides: Bootstrap default affirmed, documented failure. bootstrap dominates analytic method angles everywhere (.90–.95 vs .76–.88; analytic angle coverage improve 250→1000 boundary truths) ζ N ≥ 500. design’s acceptance band ([.90, .98] default every N/parameter) fails: ζ -covers N ≤ 500 (.758, misses one-sided truth — ζ̂’s boundary bias, percentile intervals inherit), β -covers boundary truths every N (~.77, flat N — classic percentile-bootstrap failure parameter near boundary, structural rather small-sample). BCa/alternative-interval follow-recorded ROADMAP (post-M4 note). summary() caution calibrated (constants R/cpm_fit.R): unconditional N = 2000; 2000 50000 conditional fit’s boundary/weak-identification markers (Heywood, removed harmonics, min β̂ < .10, Hessian condition > 1e8 — markers separated two regimes — plus multimodality flag, separately measured regime), fired markers named caution text. T = n·F̂ χ²_df truths field N: seeded KS rejects 5 6 cells (interior N=1000 passes, p = .255), tracking Heywood rates (.21–.91 across cells; boundary pile-makes T mixture). well-identified non-octant truth N = 2000 KS check passes (test-cpm_oracles.R) — boundary-regime effect, broken statistic, χ²/RMSEA octant instruments field N read accordingly (W1 vignette material). Replicate exclusions small (used 411–494 500 per cell; acceptance criterion; zero worker errors) counted RDS. title: circumplex — design notes
text: RNG contract (invariant, inventory): function consumes R’s global RNG stream iff statistical output stochastic (resampling simulation). Every entry point documents fact follows set.seed()-immediately-convention; everything else — including internal conveniences optimizer multi-starts, jitter, tie-breaking — must deterministic leave .Random.seed untouched. (Restated 2026-07-03 earlier “ssm_analyze() entry point consumes RNG stream,” froze -true inventory instead stating rule produced .) RNG-consuming entry points, now four (ssm_score(), ssm_parameters(), tidying functions deterministic): ssm_analyze(), cpm_fit(ci_method = "bootstrap"), cpm_simulate(), ssm_ci_accuracy() (latter three landed M4 — see devel/m4-browne-design.md §3.5/§8 devel/m4-ci-accuracy-spec.md §3). ssm_analyze() — call set.seed() immediately get reproducible confidence intervals. reproducibility covers, per engine: cpm_fit(ci_method = "bootstrap") — call set.seed() immediately reproducible bootstrap intervals. point estimates, fit indices, correlation-matrix path’s analytic (Wald) intervals deterministic never touch stream; raw-data path’s bootstrap . ssm_analyze()’s bootstrap engine, resample indices drawn master stream one block refitting, given seed yields intervals regardless many replicates later excluded degenerate non-convergent. cpm_simulate() — consumes stream directly (via boot::boot()): draws common-factor scores, unique deviates, fixed order, given seed reproduces draw exactly. fit simulates deterministic. ssm_ci_accuracy() — call set.seed() immediately . draws one sample.int() value caller’s stream seed internal L’Ecuyer-CMRG generator, gives every simulated (condition × replicate) dataset deterministic substream via nextRNGStream(), restores caller’s .Random.seed RNG kind exit — results given seed identical regardless parallel/ncpus, caller’s stream left advanced exactly one sample.int() draw. reproducibility mean: Cross-engine agreement. Bootstrap Monte Carlo draw RNG stream unrelated ways (resample indices vs. MVN deviates); seed gives engine internally-reproducible mutually unrelated draws. Statistical agreement engines separate, validated property (see Monte Carlo log entry MILESTONES.md) — RNG-identity one. Stability across boots. Increasing boots (draw/resample count) changes draw sequence therefore exact CI, design — draws tighten Monte Carlo error, reproduce smaller run’s numbers. distribution CIs approximate invariant. Stability across R/platform versions. Ordinary caveat: set.seed() reproducibility depends RNGkind() defaults, R occasionally changes across major versions.

title: circumplex — design notes
text: public ggplot2 extension (M3) turns former inline plotting code composable pieces: ggcircumplex() (canvas), geom_ssm_point() / geom_ssm_arc() (polar-native layers), scale_x_circumplex() (angle axis). ssm_plot_circle()/_curve() built ; ssm_plot_contrast() Cartesian difference plot stays independent. Architecture. Canvas (ggcircumplex() → internal circle_base()): rings, spokes, labels drawn geometry (ggforce::geom_circle, geom_segment, geom_label) theme_void() base hidden continuous x/y scales radius space roughly [-5, 5]. plot constructor, coord. Point geom (GeomSsmPoint ⊂ GeomPoint): amplitude/displacement → Cartesian transform runs setup_data(), executes position scale training, computed x/y train panel range correctly. Arc stat (StatSsmArc ⊂ ggforce::StatArcBar): compute_panel() injects x0/y0/r0/r/start/end SSM bounds (0/360 unwrap) delegates parent via ggproto_parent() polygon tessellation. idiomatic split (Stat computes positions; Geom draws). Label resolution: shared resolve_circumplex_labels() backs canvas axis scale, identical angles/labels/instrument inputs label contexts consistently. Best-practices review (V6 verdict, 2026-07). after_stat()/after_scale(): used, correctly . arc’s Stat feeds GeomArcBar’s required aesthetics directly (ggforce ), aesthetic needs post-scale remapping. absence right, gap. ggforce dependency: KEEP (acceptance’s “keep iff simplifies arcs”). supplies () annular-sector polygon tessellation (StatArcBar/arcPaths), StatSsmArc reuses inheritance rather reimplementing — hand-rolling wrap-aware annular-wedge tessellator exactly fiddly geometry worth owning — (b) geom_circle canvas rings. already mature hard dependency (Imports, ≥ 0.3.0); dropping add risk benefit. See also Dependency policy . Known limitations / accepted trade-offs (deliberate M3, candidates later milestone; “fix” casually — risks V4 snapshot stability byte-identical output depended ). amax per-layer parameter, shared state. amplitude→radius scale factor lives ggcircumplex() geom, caller must keep equal; mismatch silently misaligns points rings. ggplot2 first-class way geom read plot-level constant. idiomatic fix CoordCircumplex (carrier scale) owns amax polar transform — substantial rewrite drawn-geometry canvas, deferred. configurable amplitude center belongs future scale/coord (limits), constructor: early exported ggcircumplex(amin=) relabelled rings amin..amax scale geoms mapped amplitude *5/amax (center = 0), silently mislabelling axis. amin removed public constructor (2026-07-03, R3); circle_base() keeps internal amin = 0 default . canvas respond themes. rings/spokes/labels drawn geoms theme_void(), + theme_bw() etc. restyle . Themed panel furniture require coord/scale approach . data layers theme scale normally. na.rm effectively always TRUE. geoms silently drop rows missing amplitude/displacement (degenerate profiles location), regardless flag — minor deviation ggplot2 convention na.rm = FALSE warns. R2 (2026-07-03) higher-level ssm_plot_circle() compensates detecting undefined-displacement profiles warning name geoms drop ; raw geoms remain silent (profile labels name). GeomSsmPoint/StatSsmArc ggproto generators exported (layer constructors ). Fine use; exporting (@format NULL) let others subclass — cheap future addition.

title: circumplex — design notes
text: Gurtman (1992) JPSP — SSM foundations; Gurtman & Pincus (2003) — methods. Wright, Pincus, Conroy, & Hilsenroth (2009) JPA — group comparison. Zimmermann & Wright (2017) Assessment — bootstrapped SSM, interpretation benchmarks (fit ≥ .70/.80; |e|, ≥ .15 “marked” correlation SSM). Browne (1992) Psychometrika — stochastic process model (ROADMAP M4). Grassi, Luccio, & Di Blas (2010) Behav Res Methods — CircE, archived R implementation Browne’s model ROADMAP M4 replaces.

text: Imports kept minimal (boot, ggplot2, ggforce, htmlTable, Rcpp, rlang, stats). Heavier optional functionality goes Suggests graceful degradation (ggrepel, kableExtra). title: circumplex — design notes
text: Numerical regression tests pin published/known values (test-ssm_analysis.R uses seeded bootstraps — changing RNG flow breaks intentionally). vdiffr snapshots plots; snapshot tests print methods. C++ helpers tested base-R equivalents (colMeans, cor pairwise). Boundary suite (0°/360°, ±180° contrasts, flat profiles) — expanded ROADMAP M1; required estimation change. CPM validation battery (M4/B6, test-cpm_oracles.R + helper-cpm-oracles.R): published CIRCUM/CircE oracles transcribed Grassi et al. (2010) model-difference triage documented devel/m4-browne-design.md §11; OpenMx/lavaan cross-implementation oracles (Suggests, skip--absent); sampling-consistency T-calibration simulation checks (skip--CRAN); heavy coverage oracle lives devel/m4-coverage-oracle.R run /statistical-validation, never R CMD check.

title: Evaluate circumplex structure (Acton & Revelle, 2004) — fit_structure
text: Run exploratory circumplex-structure criteria Acton Revelle (2004) set scales return one object bundling tests. Four criteria computed first two unrotated principal-axis factors scales' correlation matrix – Fisher Test equal axes, Gap Test equal spacing, Variance Test (VT2) Rotation Test interstitiality – statistic classified simulation-derived, scoring- scale-count-specific cutoffs. fifth test, RANDALL (Hubert & Arabie, 1987; Tracey, 1997), evaluates hypothesised circular order scales randomization test yields genuine p-value.

title: Evaluate circumplex structure (Acton & Revelle, 2004) — fit_structure
text: data data frame (matrix) containing circumplex scales. scales character vector column names (numeric vector column indexes) selecting circumplex scales, hypothesised circular order (order RANDALL's order hypothesis). least four scales required. scoring Either "deviation" (default; row-mean-center scales analysis) "raw" (analyze scores given). Selects matching interpretive cutoffs. ridge non-negative ridge added diagonal correlation matrix (rescaled unit diagonal) repair non-positive-definite matrix factoring; default 0, matches cutoff calibration. Raise factoring fails, noting nonzero ridge moves statistics calibrated scale. n_perm NULL (default) compute RANDALL's p-value exact enumeration, available nine scales; otherwise single positive whole number Monte Carlo relabelings (required ten scales). Monte Carlo path draws global RNG stream, set seed set.seed() beforehand reproducibility.

title: circumplex 1.2.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-02 SSM plotting functions (ssm_plot_circle(), ssm_plot_curve(), ssm_plot_contrast()) now warn given unrecognized argument (e.g., misspelled parameter name) instead silently ignoring . Matrix input now works wherever documented. ssm_analyze(), ssm_score(), ipsatize(), score(), norm_standardize(), self_standardize() previously errored given matrix despite advertising matrix support; now coerce data frame internally. ssm_score() now accepts numeric column indexes scales (e.g., scales = 1:8), consistent documentation ssm_analyze(); previously required character names. Printing SSM object (via print() summary()) now adds note profile whose model fit inadequate (R-squared < .70; interpret elevation) whose amplitude confidence interval includes zero (displacement interpretable). notes apply profiles , contrast rows. Contrast displacement estimates confidence intervals now always reported angular branch. Previously, contrasts near ±180 degrees, estimate (reported (-180, 180]) fall numerically outside confidence interval geometrically inside, interval centered bootstrap circular mean’s branch. interval now shifted full circle needed (width meaning unchanged; results away boundary identical), interval endpoints may exceed ±180 degrees contrast straddles boundary. norm_standardize() now matches scale normative data angular position rather exact numeric equality, 0 360 degrees treated angle (previously passing 0 scale stored 360 failed cryptic error). angle matching normative row, one, now produces informative error naming available angles. Degenerate profiles now handled explicitly instead returning numerical noise. flat (zero-variance) profile returns NA displacement fit warning (previously arbitrary angle -Inf); profile real variance zero amplitude returns NA displacement fit 0. Bootstrap resamples produce degenerate profiles (e.g., resampled measure zero variance) longer crash ssm_analyze(); excluded confidence intervals warning reporting count. Genuinely small amplitudes unaffected — degeneracy test operates machine-noise scale . Fixed bug missing (NA) value grouping variable ssm_analyze() crashed cryptic error pairwise deletion (listwise = FALSE). observations now dropped analysis message reporting many removed, deletion modes; observations remain, clear error given. Fixed bug length requirements character arguments never enforced (is_null_or_char() dropped n argument). ssm_analyze() now errors measures_labels match number measures (given without measures), ssm_plot_circle()/ssm_plot_curve() now error angle_labels match number angles (previously mismatched labels silently recycled onto wrong scales), ssm_table()/html_render() now require caption single string. Fixed bug ssm_score() silently ignored angles argument always used octants(): custom angle sets length produced incorrect results without warning, angle sets different length (e.g., poles() four scales) errored. Results ssm_score() default angles = octants() unaffected. (found 2026-07 audit)
